title: Pullback tensor and cover descent for shifted etale lines
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $X$ any scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the ordinary unbounded etale derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], and cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For $n\in\mathbf Z$, say that a complex has line shape $n$ if it is isomorphic in the derived category to $L[n]$ for a locally constant sheaf $L$ of $A$-modules [def-constructible-locally-constant] with every separably closed geometric stalk isomorphic to $A$. Then:
(1) A complex of line shape $n$ is tensor-invertible; its inverse has line shape $-n$.
(2) For any scheme morphism $v:X'\to X$, exact inverse image preserves line shape $n$, with $v^*(L[n])\cong(v^*L)[n]$; if $M,N$ have line shapes $m,n$, then $M\otimes_A^LN$ has line shape $m+n$.
(3) Let $\{u_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a small jointly surjective family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]. If every $u_i^*M$ has line shape $n$, then $M$ has line shape $n$, and one may take $L=\mathcal H^{-n}(M)$. Also, a morphism $\alpha$ in $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ is invertible if every $u_i^*\alpha$ is invertible. Empty $X$ and the empty covering family of empty $X$ are permitted.

proof.text: Use the existing ordinary-etale interfaces recorded in lean.note. For M ≅ F[n], take the actual sheaf D = ihom(F, unit). The upstream tensorIhomUnitIsoOfIsLocallyConstantSheaf gives eFD : F tensor D ≅ unit. Choose a locally constant datum for F, discard its empty members, and on each remaining member choose an algebraic-closure point. nonempty_iso_unit_of_isConstant and upperStarCompSheafFiberIso identify the restricted F with the unit. For each restricted D, compose the inverse left unitor, the inverse trivialization of F, the monoidal tensorator of exact inverse image, the image of eFD and the inverse monoidal unit comparison. This is a concrete isomorphism v_i^* D ≅ unit, requiring no internal-Hom comparison.

Descend local constancy of D through etaleCoverOfJointlySurjective using IsLocallyConstantSheaf.of_cover. Every separably closed geometric point lifts to one of the nonempty covering members. Compose upperStarCompSheafFiberIso, the restricted-D trivialization, uliftSheafFiberIso and sheafFiberUnitIso to identify its stalk with A. This treats separably closed points directly and does not pass through field extension. The argument allows empty X and the zero ring.

The upstream ObjectProperty.flat_of_tensorIso applied to eFD and to braiding followed by eFD makes F and D flat. singleFunctorObjTensorIso and singleFunctorObjUnitIso identify both degree-zero derived tensor orders with constantComplex. Take N = single(D)[-n], with the shape proved in step 2. Map the given M ≅ single(F)[n] through the derived tensor bifunctor, apply derivedTensorShiftIso in each order, map the degree-zero evaluation isomorphisms through shift, and cancel the zero shifts n + (-n) and (-n) + n. These explicit composites prove both inverse isomorphisms.

Pullback and tensor stability are the existing upstream IsShiftedRankOneLocalSystem.leftDerivedUpperStar, leftDerivedUpperStarShiftSingleIso and tensor declarations, already exposed by the public AffineSpace import. No new proof or duplicate statement for those clauses is needed.

For an arbitrarily universe-indexed cover, choose above each point x of X one covering index j(x) and a point y(x) mapping to x. This yields a jointly surjective family indexed by X itself. Apply upstream IsShiftedRankOneLocalSystem.of_jointlySurjective to this family; its existing cohomology-vanishing and single-degree truncation argument gives F, its local constancy and stalk properties, and e : M ≅ single(F)[n]. Compose e with singleFunctors.shiftIso to get M ≅ single_{-n}(F). Apply homologyFunctor(-n) and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso to obtain eH : H^{-n}(M) ≅ F. Transport local constancy and stalk isomorphisms along eH, and compose e with the shifted singleFunctor image of eH.symm. The result is exactly the specified presentation by H^{-n}(M). No derived presentations are glued.

For morphisms use the same point-indexed subfamily and apply upstream isIso_of_isIso_leftDerivedUpperStar_map_of_jointlySurjective. This theorem already proves the unbounded cohomology criterion from exact inverse image and sheaf conservativity. Empty covers and empty schemes are allowed: the point-indexed family is empty when X is empty, and none of the constructions above selects a point of X without already having one.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs 2 and 4; T3 reuses the existing upstream ordinary-etale evaluation, flat single-object tensor, shifted local system and descent interfaces recorded in lean.note. The inverse dual is locally trivialized by canceling F in the evaluation pairing; arbitrary-universe descent is reduced to the family indexed by points of X and its witness transported to the prescribed cohomology sheaf.

tool_uses.why: General ringed-site rank-one dual, evaluation and flatness; the unit smooth-duality route needs this sheaf algebra tool and does not replace it.
General K-flatness of bounded-above flat complexes; applies to the single shifted sheaf models on the small etale site.
Ordinary sheaf tensor unit and symmetry, used for the inverse and tensor local models.
Restriction of ordinary sheaf tensor to a slice; needed to compute the common trivializing cover.
Exact constant-coefficient inverse image for arbitrary scheme morphisms; this is coefficient transport, not a six-functor route change.
General exact-functor termwise construction, including shifts and single objects, for the ordinary unbounded derived category.
General ordinary etale derived pullback/stalk comparison in degree zero; establishes the A-linear stalk identifications.
General exact constant-module/stalk comparison, used only on single complexes to recover the constant value module.
Existence of algebraic closures to choose a geometric point of a nonempty trivializing member and to compare separably closed points.
General lifting of a geometric point to a jointly surjective etale cover; tests stalks of a locally trivial module.
Natural stalk comparison under an extension of separably closed fields; bridges arbitrary separably closed points and algebraically closed test points.
Pullback stability of locally constant sheaves for arbitrary scheme maps; needed by the pullback clause.
General cover detection of sheaf isomorphisms; applied to zero cohomology and to the cohomology of a derived morphism.
General single-degree truncation criterion; produces the global sheaf H^{-n}(M) without gluing derived objects.
General cohomological detection of unbounded derived isomorphisms; no boundedness hypothesis is introduced.

Etale inverse image equals restriction to the slice site; bridges the trivializing-datum restrictions of def-constructible-locally-constant with the inverse-image stalk comparisons (added by the cc reviewer).

The statement is unchanged from live, there are no new nodes, the item is not dropped or superseded, there is no SGA citation and no cycle (closure of 294 nodes). The maths is sound. Inverse is L^vee[-n] via lem-pur-sheaf-line-evaluation-inverse-pair, with single-term K-flat tensors. Pullback uses module-exact inverse image for arbitrary v. The tensor of two lines has shift m+n. Descent follows blueprint ¶4: H^q(M)=0 for q≠-n by jointly-surjective conservativity, then concentrated-single with r=-n, then L=H^{-n}(M) shown locally ≅A. Morphism descent uses the unbounded cohomology criterion. Separably closed stalks come from geometric-point-field-extension. The empty X, empty-family and A=0 cases check. One repairable C3/C4 fault, used in three places: steps 1, 2 and 8 conflated the inverse image u^*L (where the stalk and cohomology comparisons apply) with the restriction L|_U (where the trivializing datum and the composite cover live), and no cited node identifies the two. FIXED by citing lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction (ρ: j^{-1}G≅G|_Y, natural, hence A-linear) in steps 1, 2 and 8, with the stalk isomorphism chain written out. Step 3 also only had a cover of X while the line-evaluation node needs a trivializing cover of every object; I added the pullback of the cover with a def-weil-pbc-etale-site citation. proof_deps and split_report.tool_uses were updated.
